title: Systematic Difference between Ionized and Molecular Gas Velocity Dispersions in z ∼ 1-2 Disks and Local Analogs
question: Compare the molecular and ionized gas velocity dispersion in 9 nearby turbulent disk galaxies (analogues to z ~ 1-2 galaxies) and 12 galaxies at z ~ 0.5-2.5, and evaluate the impact on Toomre Q, disk pressure, and star formation/feedback models.

what.value: Total gas mass and gas fraction of DYNAMO galaxies

evidence.quote: The total gas mass and gas fraction of each galaxy were derived in Fisher et al. (2014), White et al. (2017), and Fisher et al. (2017a, 2019) using CO(1-0) observations from Plateau de Bure.

external_data.citation: Fisher et al. (2014), White et al. (2017), Fisher et al. (2017a, 2019)

what.value: Star formation rates of DYNAMO galaxies

evidence.quote: The star formation rates have also been derived in previous DYNAMO papers using the H α flux corrected for attenuation (Green et al. 2017; Fisher et al. 2019), where SFR [M ⊙ yr − 1 ] = 5 . 53 × 10 − 42 L Hα [erg s − 1 ] (Hao et al. 2011).

external_data.citation: Green et al. (2017); Fisher et al. (2019)

what.value: Ionized gas kinematic properties for C13-1 and D15-3

evidence.quote: The ionized gas kinematic properties for these targets were taken from Bekiaris et al. (2016) which used a very similar kinematic modeling method.

what.value: Properties of 12 galaxies at z ~ 0.5-2.5 (SMM J2315-0102, HLS115, Cosmic Snake, A521, SHiZELS-19, and 7 PHIBSS galaxies)

evidence.quote: We combine our sample with 12 galaxies at z ∼ 0.5-2.5 from the literature.

evidence.quote: We show local galaxies from the THINGS-HERACLES survey (Leroy et al. 2008, 2009; Mogotsi et al. 2016), GHASP (Dunne et al. 2000; Leroy et al. 2005; Epinat et al. 2010; Torres-Flores et al. 2011) and nearby galaxies at z ∼ 0 . 2 from Cortese et al. (2017).

recipe.goal: Extract 2D kinematic moment maps for molecular and ionized gas
recipe.method: Compute moment 1 and 2 maps from CO(3-2) and CO(4-3) cubes using immoments in CASA with a 3σ threshold; perform spaxel-by-spaxel Gaussian fits on Hα or Hβ and subtract instrumental broadening in quadrature.
key_parameters: 3σ threshold parameter above noise level for immoments; σ_instr = 24 km s^-1 for GMOS

recipe.goal: Model 3D galaxy kinematics and extract intrinsic velocity dispersion and rotation velocity
recipe.method: Fit 3D disk models directly to CO(3-2), CO(4-3), and Hβ/Hα datacubes using GalPaK3D convolved with the PSF and LSF, and subtract unresolved velocity shear in quadrature from observed dispersion maps to obtain radial profiles.
key_parameters: arctan velocity profile; exponential radial flux profile; constant velocity dispersion over disk; radial bins of 300 pc
assumptions: Disk inclinations fixed from SDSS r-band photometry; constant intrinsic velocity dispersion across the disk

recipe.goal: Compare ionized and molecular gas velocity dispersions and correlate with gas fraction, redshift, and SFR
recipe.method: Subtract thermal broadening and HII expansion (σ_th = 15 km s^-1) in quadrature from σ_0,ion, compute the ratio and log-linear fits against f_gas, and compute Spearman rank correlations with f_gas and SFR.
key_parameters: σ_th = 15 km s^-1; fixed slope a = 0.87 for log(σ_0) vs f_gas
assumptions: Galactic CO-to-H2 conversion factor α_CO = 4.36 (including 1.36 for helium); Kroupa (2001) IMF; Λ-CDM cosmology with H_0 = 67 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Ω_M = 0.31, Ω_Λ = 0.69

recipe.goal: Test for a broad molecular gas velocity dispersion component via spectral stacking
recipe.method: Shift spaxel spectra in outer galaxy regions to a common velocity using moment 1 maps, stack deep and shallow CO(3-2) and Hβ spectra for G04-1, G08-5, and G14-1, and fit Gaussian profiles.

recipe.goal: Derive half-light radii, Toomre Q, and disk hydrostatic and dynamical equilibrium pressures
recipe.method: Fit exponential profiles to Hα, CO, and HST F125W maps to obtain R_1/2; compute Toomre Q = σ_0 κ / (π G Σ_g), midplane hydrostatic pressure P_H, and dynamical equilibrium pressure P_DE under three tracer/α_CO assumptions, and fit the log(Σ_SFR)-log(P_H) relation.
key_parameters: Iterative variable α_CO(Σ_CO) convergence threshold of 0.1 using Eq. 31 of Bolatto et al. (2013)
assumptions: Solar metallicity for variable α_CO; HI surface density Σ_HI = 5 M_sun pc^-2; stellar velocity dispersion σ_* ≈ 0.5 sqrt(π G l_* Σ_*) with l_* = R_1/2,* / 1.76; stellar scale height h_z = 100 pc (local) and 630 pc (DYNAMO and high-z)

answer_key.quantity: Mean ratio of thermal-corrected ionized to molecular gas velocity dispersion (zero-offset factor)

evidence.quote: We find that the resolved velocity dispersion is systematically lower by a factor 2 . 45 ± 0 . 38 for the molecular gas compared to the ionized gas, after correcting for thermal broadening.

score_reason: The ALMA project codes, analysis software (CASA immoments, GalPaK3D), parametric disk model forms, and derived per-galaxy kinematic and pressure tables are clearly reported, but imaging parameters and fixed inclination values per target are omitted.
rediscovery_reason: Both ALMA datasets (2017.1.00239.S and 2019.1.00447.S) are public in the ALMA archive, standard pipeline reduction was used, GalPaK3D is publicly available, and per-galaxy molecular rotation velocities, velocity dispersions, half-light radii, and pressures are tabulated as clear numeric benchmarks.
